next.reason: 1985: "Literal-1 or the content of the data item referenced by identifier-1 is the name of the called program."; 2023: "If identifier-1 references a program-pointer data item, the data item referenced by identifier-1 contains the location of the program". 2023 keeps literal/alphanumeric identifier content as the program-name and non-COBOL naming implementor-defined, but adds a case: identifier-1 as program-pointer holds a location, not a name.
